concerns.text: FR-006 requires verification that the pipeline runs on a CPU‑only environment (no GPU/CUDA libraries). No task explicitly checks for the absence of GPU dependencies or confirms a CPU‑only execution context.

SC-002 mandates reporting the Type II error delta (1 – power) relative to the 30 m baseline. The final‑report task (T016) mentions inclusion of this metric but there is no dedicated task that computes or validates the delta before the report is generated.
